senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;
son of Elishama of the royal family of Judah and father of Ishmael who murdered Gedaliah
a Levite, one of the 4 sons of Asaph the minstrel
a Levite in the reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah

strongs.def: Nethanjah, the name of four Israelites
strongs.from: or נְתַנְיָהוּ; from H5414 (נָתַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); given of Jah
